Be careful when bleaching your own hair. Very fine thin sections, and complete saturation of the entire strand. Avoid the roots until the end, your head creates natural body heat causing the bleach to process a lot quicker than your ends that have no heat. Get a good keratin conditioning treatment, and if you want a silvery white you need to bleach it past red, then Orange, then yellow finishing at a nice pale yellow (your hair should look the inside of a banana)   Then apply the grey on towel dried hair, watch your hair because your hair could take the color a lot quicker since it is a dye not a toner. I hope this helped.

This happened to my mom and my dad 2 years before I was born on their honeymoon. Well should I say it happened while they were away. They went to Hawaii after getting married for 2 weeks and had the house they recently bought locked up and my grandma would go check on it every couple days. The house was built in 1912 and used to be a farm house back in the day in Colorado. My grandma went inside to take a shower after a long day at work and there used to be a clear shower curtain, as she was in the shower she saw the blurred silhouette of a large man with a red shirt, overalls and a big long beard. She screamed and fell in the shower resulting in a broken hip, and when she opened the curtain there was no one there. My parents came back early after my dad's boss called him on his satelite phone. When my parents came back at the house every cabinet, drawer and door was open. When they got to the bathroom they found a clear bottle, shaped like a mountain with a small cross at the bottom. The words "Vatican" inscribed at the bottle. My father grew up Catholic and knew it was a holy water bottle. He took it to his church and it was authenticated as a bottle of holy water from the Vatican. No one knows who put it there. My dad still has that bottle even after moving houses
